claim: Central Province accounted for 10.3% of Sri Lanka's nominal GDP in 2023, third behind Western Province (43.7%) and North Western Province (10.9%).

metric.denominator: Sri Lanka nominal GDP by province
metric.basis: Central Bank of Sri Lanka provincial gross domestic product series
metric.source_definition: provincial nominal GDP share; not Kandy-city GDP

bounded_by: Central Province includes areas outside Kandy city; the metric cannot be used as a city GDP estimate.
notes: Weakens any unqualified claim that Kandy is the country's second economic centre.
